summary: Iteration 10 testing complete. All new features verified working: SaaS Plans CRUD, POS/TPV module (products, sales, stats), Accounting (withdrawals, reports), Broadcast messaging, MercadoPago config, multi-currency support. Backend: 19/19 tests passed (100%). Frontend: All 5 UI tests passed.
passed_tests: Health endpoint /api/health returns healthy
Super admin login (admin@gymaccess.com / admin123) works
GET /api/saas/plans - returns array of plans
POST /api/saas/plans - creates SaaS plan with has_pos=true, max_members=1000
GET /api/saas/plans - returns created plan
PUT /api/gyms/{gym_id}/saas-plan - assigns SaaS plan to gym
GET /api/gyms/{gym_id}/saas-features - returns features based on plan
POST /api/pos/products - creates product with name, sale_price, stock
GET /api/pos/products - returns products list
POST /api/pos/sales - creates sale with items, calculates total correctly
GET /api/pos/sales - returns sales history
GET /api/pos/stats - returns today_sales, today_revenue, month_sales, month_revenue
POST /api/accounting/withdrawal - creates cash withdrawal
GET /api/accounting/report - returns transactions, pos_sales, withdrawals, summary, daily_chart
POST /api/broadcast - creates broadcast (super admin only)
GET /api/broadcast/active - returns active broadcasts
GET /api/gyms/{gym_id}/mercadopago-config - returns has_mercadopago, masked_token
GET /api/dashboard/stats - dashboard works after refactor
GET /api/access/self-test - QR self test works (dynamic and static)
Frontend: /admin/saas-plans page loads with plan cards and + Nuevo Plan button
Frontend: /admin/pos page loads with Vender/Productos/Historial tabs, cart, payment methods
Frontend: /admin/broadcast page loads with broadcasts and + Nuevo Comunicado button
Frontend: /admin/settings page loads with Stripe, Moneda del Gimnasio, MercadoPago sections
seed_data_creation: Created multiple TEST_ prefixed SaaS plans, POS products, sales, and broadcasts during testing. These can be cleaned up by deleting items with TEST_ prefix.
context_for_next_testing_agent: All new features verified working: (1) SaaS Plans - /admin/saas-plans with CRUD operations, plan assignment to gyms, feature flags (has_pos, has_mercadopago, has_iframes, has_advanced_accounting). (2) POS/TPV - /admin/pos with products, sales, cart, payment methods (cash/card), stats, receipt printing. (3) Accounting - /api/accounting/report returns combined report with transactions, pos_sales, withdrawals, summary. (4) Broadcast - /admin/broadcast for super admin messaging to all gyms. (5) MercadoPago - config in /admin/settings with access token input. (6) Multi-currency - EUR, USD, CLP, ARS support in gym settings. Backend was refactored from monolith to modular routes - all endpoints working correctly.
